$schema_note: LUMI design tokens v2 (2026-08-06). Mirrors tokens/lumi-theme.css. Usage: references/design-rules.md. Repository language: English only (red line).

night_text.note: dark-canvas text is cold white, never pure white

semantic.note: one color, one meaning: accent = emphasis/pass; seal = warnings only, never decoration

chart.note: CVD-validated triple; never restyled with the brand palette

font.note: dual voice: values that will be read out and verified use data (tabular-nums always on, fixed-width digit boxes for counters); prose uses narrative. D-DIN = SIL OFL (Datto 2017), Latin-only, CJK falls back

typography.note: Latin eyebrows: small ALL-CAPS + tracking; the CJK display equivalent is size contrast + tracking, never scaling alone
